svg.text: Azure Firewall Hub vs. Third-Party NVA HA & Gateway Load Balancer
Managed IDPS (67k+ rules) & Outbound TLS Proxy
- Network Rules preserve RFC 1918 + RFC 6598 IPs
- App Rules & DNAT proxy/SNAT to FW instance IP
- Never place a return UDR for AzureFirewallSubnet
- Zone-redundant FW requires StandardV2 NAT Gateway
- Inbound WAF + TLS termination: pair App Gateway v2
Port 0 / Protocol All (TCP, UDP, ICMP) | VIP .4
ARS Next-Hop IP = ILB VIP (.4) or ECMP across NVAs
- Multi-NIC NVAs MUST return probes out ingress NIC
- Enforce PBR / separate VRFs for Untrust vs Trust
- Active-Active reverse 5-tuple can hit another NVA:
use SNAT, session sync, or Active-Passive probe
- Active-Passive option: zero SNAT, single-VM cap
Provider Security VNet: GWLB + NVA VTEPs
HA Ports Only | Symmetric 5-Tuple Flow Stickiness
- Chains onto Std Public LB or Std VM NIC IP config
- Preserves internet client IP with zero spoke UDRs
- Cannot be used as UDR next hop or with Global LB
- North-South public flows only (not private E-W)
Azure Networking Field Architect Handbook | Architecture Reference
